When booking calls come in on every shift, after hours, at peak and on holidays, and not every one gets answered, they want to turn every guest who calls into a booking. founder_screens.answer: Hotel groups miss about 5% of their reservation calls even with a central reservations office or a call center: after hours, during peak hours, on holidays. Every call that rings out is a booking that goes to an online travel agency or a competitor, a seven-figure rounding error for a mid-sized group; we started Codyco after a friend told us how much money he was losing from missed calls, and one 53-room hotel made €5,000 in extra bookings in its first 4 weeks with us.

keel read back.statement: Reservation agents at hotel groups miss a share of reservation calls, even with a central reservations office or a call center: after hours, during peak hours and on holidays.
